open_world.raw_value: If any Company 401(k) Plan is terminated pursuant to Parent’s request, the applicable Affected Employees shall be eligible to participate in a benefit plan intended to qualify pursuant to Section 401(k) of the Code that is maintained by Parent or one of its Subsidiaries as soon as reasonably practicable following the Closing Date, and such Affected Employees shall be entitled to effect a direct rollover of any eligible rollover distributions (as defined in Section 402(c)(4) of the Code), including any outstanding loans, to such plan maintained by Parent or its Subsidiaries

attributes.why_unmapped: RETIREMENT_401K: If Parent requests pre-closing termination of the Company's 401(k) plan, Affected Employees become eligible for a Parent-maintained 401(k) plan as soon as reasonably practicable after Closing, with direct rollover rights for eligible distributions and outstanding loans.

open_world.raw_value: Notwithstanding Section 6.5(a), Parent shall, or shall cause the Surviving Company or another its Subsidiaries to, (i) honor the terms of the annual cash bonus program for 2026 as in effect at the Closing Date (the “2026 Bonus Program”) and (ii) determine the amount payable under the 2026 Bonus Program in a manner consistent with the Company’s past practices, except that, in each case, any bonus payable under the 2026 Bonus Program shall be prorated based on a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of days between January 1, 2026 and the Closing Date (including the Closing Date) and the denominator of which is 365

attributes.why_unmapped: BONUS_OR_LTI: The 2026 annual cash bonus program is honored on its existing terms and calculated consistent with past practice, with any payable bonus prorated by days elapsed from January 1, 2026 through the Closing Date over 365.

open_world.raw_value: Following the date of this Agreement, to the extent applicable, the Company shall provide Parent with a list of employees who would be affected by any facility closings or employee layoffs or reductions in force that would trigger the notice requirements under the WARN Act and that would occur between the date of this Agreement and the Closing Date

attributes.why_unmapped: WARN_OR_CBA: Pre-closing obligation for the Company to give Parent a list of employees who would be affected by facility closings or layoffs that would trigger WARN Act notice requirements between signing and Closing.
